findings.title: Chart text is 3.7 px on a phone tile at first paint and 5.6 px in the phone dialog; the 8 px floor never holds
findings.claim: In the order hui-card mounts a card (setConfig, hass, append) the compact chart renders FONT_BASE at 3.70 px on a 359 px tile and nothing re-renders on resize; when the floor does apply it yields 7.42 px because it divides by the host width, and the expanded dialog has no floor (5.6 px on a 375 px phone).
findings.mechanism: _maybeRender gates on a signature that omits the measured width; connectedCallback's ResizeObserver only calls _cacheRect(); compactFontUnits(this._measuredCardWidth()) uses the host rect (359) while the svg is 333 px after ha-card's border and padding; renderChart keeps FONT_EXPANDED (15 units) for the dialog regardless of its rendered width.

evidence.unit: px axis font, Lovelace order (RESULT font_px_lovelace); renders_resize=0; font_px_attached=7.42; card_geometry.mjs chart font 5.6 px in every phone expanded state
evidence.machine: Apple M1 8 GB, macOS Darwin 25.6.0, Node 20.10.0, Playwright 1.49.0 / Chromium 1148
evidence.contention_note: fan-out: three other auditors on the box, load1 2.8-8.5; counts and layout-engine pixel sizes only, load-independent

perturbation.change: In connectedCallback make the ResizeObserver callback call this.render() (or add the measured width to _signature); separately measure the .chartwrap width instead of the host, and floor the expanded font like the compact one
perturbation.observed_value: font_px_lovelace 3.70 (expected ~7.4 after the change); font_px_attached 7.42 (8.00 after measuring the svg)

findings.metric_definition: On-screen axis font px = the chart <text> font-size attribute (viewBox units) x rendered svg width / 900, after a stated mount/resize/refresh sequence.
reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python tests/plan_view.py with a private HPO_PLANDATA
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Re-render on the first attached layout and on width change (ResizeObserver -> render, or width in the signature); size the floor from the chart's own width; floor the expanded chart's font and lane height the same way.

findings.title: Schedule-editor slots are 1.3-22 px wide and lanes 5.6 px tall on a phone; below 24 px at every viewport
findings.claim: rect.lane is 5.5/5.6/11.8/19.9 px tall (phone tile/phone dialog/tablet/desktop dialog) and this plan's slots 1.3-22 px wide on a phone, so the editor's targets are under 24 px everywhere and under 44 px on every touch device; 1,344 slot and 476 lane targets under 24 px across the 14 fine-pointer arms, 1,711 with no spacing rescue.
findings.mechanism: LANE_H = 15 viewBox units scales with the chart and is never floored; slot width is time x pixels-per-ms; the lanes are also rendered focusable in the compact tile where editing is disabled.

evidence.unit: targets under 24 px with no spacing exception across 15 arms (RESULT hit_small_24_nospacing); rect.slot 1344 + rect.lane 367 of them; coarse arm smallest slot 1.3 px, lane 5.5 px
evidence.machine: Apple M1 8 GB, macOS Darwin 25.6.0, Node 20.10.0, Playwright 1.49.0 / Chromium 1148

perturbation.change: LANE_H 15 -> 40 viewBox units (or a px floor on the lane height like the font's)

findings.metric_definition: min(width,height) of every rect.slot/rect.lane client rect; counted when < 24 px (44 px on the coarse arm) and a 24 px circle on its centre hits another target.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Floor the lane height in px (>= 24, >= 44 coarse) and give slots a minimum hit width; do not render the lanes in the compact tile.

findings.title: Axis labels collide at the plot corners at every viewport (unit label on top tick, first time label on bottom tick)
findings.claim: The value-axis unit label overlaps the top tick label by 1.9 px (phone) to 8.4 px (desktop dialog) in every chart state, and on tiles <= 400 px the first time label overlaps the left axes' bottom tick: 1,039 overlapping text pairs in 390 renders.
findings.mechanism: valueAxis draws the unit text at the axis top where the top tick label also sits; timeAxis's first label at plotL meets the value axes' lowest tick; MARGIN.top (16 units) leaves no row for the unit.

findings.title: Opacity-faded text falls below AA: the setup page's 'not configured' rows and switched-off legend chips
findings.claim: .setup-slot.empty renders the rows that say which sensor is missing at 2.99:1 (light) / 4.04:1 (dark) in 9.3 px on a phone, 600 boxes across the matrix, and .chip.off renders an active toggle's label at 2.43:1 light / 3.19:1 dark (45).
findings.mechanism: cardStyleBlock fades .setup-slot.empty to opacity 0.75 on the secondary text colour and .chip.off to opacity 0.4; both are active content (the empty row is the setup page's purpose, the off chip is a toggle).
